title: Understanding the Task
text: You need to add two new columns to the DataFrame: one for counting specific patterns in the comments and another for calculating the average of two ratings.

title: Identifying Patterns
text: For the $$'number_{of,W'}$$ column, you need to count words where 'W' is surrounded by uppercase letters. Think about how you can identify such patterns without using the 're' library.

title: Calculating the Mean
text: To calculate the mean of two numbers, you add them together and divide by $$2$$. This will help you fill in the blank for $$'mean_{Q'}$$.

title: Filling in Blank (i)
text: What method can you use to iterate over each comment in the DataFrame?

hintAnswer: lambda x: [word for word in x.split() if 'W' in word and word.isupper()]
